findings.rationale: A full policy set is defined, board-approved, published and acknowledged, with an annual review cycle.

evidence.quote: All are published on the company wiki and staff acknowledge them on hire.

findings.rationale: Security governance roles are defined and asset/resource owners are recorded.

evidence.quote: meets quarterly, reviews KPIs, risks, incidents and audit results, and records minutes.
Each asset has a named owner recorded in the inventory.

findings.rationale: Segregation is enforced for code changes and privileged access but there is no documented duties matrix covering other conflicting roles.

evidence.quote: changes require pull request and one review.

findings.remediation: Document a segregation-of-duties matrix covering conflicting roles beyond engineering.

findings.rationale: Management drives security through the Steering Committee and mandatory training tracked to completion.

evidence.quote: The Information Security Steering Committee (CISO, CTO, Head of People, Head of Legal)

findings.remediation: Maintain a documented list of relevant authorities (regulator, law enforcement, CERT) with contacts and triggers.

findings.rationale: No evidence of membership in security forums, ISACs or special interest groups.
findings.remediation: Join relevant security groups and record participation.

findings.rationale: SIEM rules exist but there is no process to collect and analyse threat intelligence.

evidence.quote: coverage not mapped to a threat model

findings.remediation: Establish a lightweight threat intelligence process feeding detection rules and risk reviews.

evidence.quote: threat modelling is done informally for large features

findings.remediation: Add a security checklist/gate to the project and feature delivery process.

findings.rationale: Endpoints, cloud and SaaS are inventoried automatically with named owners.

findings.rationale: Acceptable use and handling rules are documented and acknowledged.

evidence.quote: Customer Data may only be stored in approved systems, never on local disks or personal cloud storage.

findings.remediation: Roll out the labelling scheme and add it to onboarding and handling guidance.

findings.rationale: Transport encryption is strong, but there are no transfer rules, procedures or agreements for other channels.

findings.remediation: Define an information transfer standard covering channels, approvals and agreements.

findings.rationale: A role-based access model with owner approval is defined and applied.
